0022600009.text: The Rockets (1-0, 1st in the Southwest, 3rd in the West) visit the Spurs (0-1, 4th in the Southwest and 1 game back, 10th in the West) in Houston's second game of the season, with Houston on a W1 streak and San Antonio on an L1 streak. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Houston lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 145-120 loss in San Antonio on March 8, 2026. Houston is without Reed Sheppard (knee bruise) and Steven Adams (calf soreness), both listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, while San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain) and has De'Aaron Fox (wrist sprain) and Keldon Johnson (mouth laceration) listed as day-to-day game-time decisions.
